question: Does Robinson & Frueh 2025 pre-empt the cat-4 L_J2000-ambiguity framing, and which of its implementation pieces are worth transplanting?
hypothesis: RF25 does not encroach on the cat-4 framing (their continuous omega-bands are axisymmetric cat-2 symmetry, not body-Casimir analysis); its NLL loss with sigma_k weighting + signal rescaling is the highest-value transplant.
narrative_md: Full read of Robinson & Frueh 2025 (37 pp). Encroachment: RF25 does NOT pre-empt the cat-4 framing — their continuous 1D omega-bands are on the axisymmetric rocket body (cat-2 symmetry); on the asymmetric box-wing they find 90/112 solutions but never analyse them through the body-frame Casimir/polhode lens (zero 'polhode' occurrences). Publication path open, conditional on a cohort sweep beyond N=1 and a half-page analytical extension. Implementation: their NLL loss with sigma_k weighting + signal rescaling (Eq. 3) is the highest-value transplant. Residual risk: RF74 conference companion not yet obtained.
